summaryPt: Ao imobilizar inimigos ganha Mountain's Teachings (até 30); perde um ao ser atingido ou ao usar um ataque que se beneficia delas.
statsEn: 100% Surpassing chance per enemy Power to gain Mountain's Teachings on Immobilising an enemy, up to a maximum of 30
Lose a Mountain's Teaching when you are Hit, or when you use or Sustain an Attack that benefits from Mountain's Teachings
